column.text: Bitcoin is currently decoupling from the Nasdaq while holding firm near the seventy-six thousand dollar floor despite a sharp five point seven percent daily drop, signaling that crypto-native demand is absorbing institutional ETF inflows of three hundred and seven million dollars against retail deleveraging. The market bias remains bearish as whale distribution pressure mounts with a massive entity offloading two thousand seven hundred BTC totaling over two hundred eleven million in just three days while Grayscale notes current prices offer favorable entry points for long-term investors yet altcoins face severe distribution pressure evidenced by widespread pullbacks and TAC dropping over forty percent in twenty-four hours. Technical divergence confirms this complex regime where the one-hour RSI reset to neutral at four point six seven five suggests short-term exhaustion of sellers even as daily readings stay elevated near seventy nine point four indicating prior rally fatigue. Liquidity is contracting under macro headwinds with US Treasury debt buybacks doubling and trade tensions escalating between Washington and Ottawa, creating a volatile backdrop where continuation longs carry momentum but require real catalysts rather than euphoric extensions since dollar strength pushes risk assets into defensive modes. Solana rallied back above one hundred dollars following mainnet slot time cuts while Zcash hits an eight-year high near eight hundred fifty driven by futures volume nearing ten billion amid regulatory uncertainty regarding DeFi vaults under MiCA and potential bridge exploits on Base chains that could trigger further liquidations if exploited.
